name: thruk_list_hosts
description: List monitored hosts with optional filters (hostgroup, state, name_regex, columns).

name: thruk_get_host
description: Get a single host by name.

name: thruk_list_services
description: List monitored services with optional filters (host, servicegroup, state, description_regex).

name: thruk_get_service
description: Get a single service by host and description.

name: thruk_list_hostgroups
description: List host groups.

name: thruk_list_servicegroups
description: List service groups.

name: thruk_problems
description: List all current unhandled host and service problems.

name: thruk_stats
description: Aggregated host and service statistics.

name: thruk_list_downtimes
description: List scheduled downtimes (active by default).

name: thruk_get_downtime
description: Get a single downtime by id.

name: thruk_list_comments
description: List comments (acknowledgements included).

name: thruk_sites
description: List configured Thruk backends (federated sites).

name: thruk_list_logs
description: Query raw Livestatus log entries (host/service/time/message filters).

name: thruk_list_alerts
description: List HOST/SERVICE ALERT log entries with optional state and time filters.

name: thruk_list_notifications
description: List notification log entries (class=3), optionally filtered by contact.

name: thruk_recent_events
description: Most recent monitoring events from the last N hours.

name: thruk_query
description: Escape hatch: call any Thruk REST endpoint with method, params, body.

name: thruk_run_background_query
description: Run a long-running Thruk REST request via background=1 and poll the job until completion.

name: thruk_schedule_downtime
description: Schedule a downtime on a host or service.

name: thruk_schedule_host_services_downtime
description: Schedule a downtime on ALL services of a given host.

name: thruk_schedule_propagated_host_downtime
description: Schedule a host downtime and propagate it to all child hosts (optionally triggered).

name: thruk_schedule_hostgroup_downtime
description: Schedule downtime on all hosts (or services) of a hostgroup.

name: thruk_schedule_servicegroup_downtime
description: Schedule downtime on all services (or hosts) of a servicegroup.

name: thruk_delete_downtime
description: Delete a host or service downtime by id.

name: thruk_delete_active_downtimes
description: Remove all currently active downtimes for a host or service.

name: thruk_delete_downtimes_by_filter
description: Bulk-delete downtimes matching filters (host, hostgroup, service, start_time, comment).

name: thruk_acknowledge
description: Acknowledge a host or service problem.

name: thruk_remove_acknowledgement
description: Remove an acknowledgement from a host or service.

name: thruk_recheck
description: Schedule an immediate (forced) check for a host or service.
